project_title: Robust Robot Learning Under Noisy Sensing
research_question: Does training-time observation noise improve a simulated reaching policy's performance under noisy sensing without causing unacceptable safety regressions?
objective: Improve robustness while maintaining acceptable control behavior.
primary_outcome: Noisy evaluation success rate over a fixed number of episodes.
safety_metric_definition: Count an event when either normalized actuator command reaches at least 95% of its available magnitude. This is a simulation control-limit proxy, not a physical-robot safety certification.
notes: Initial MVP uses Gymnasium Reacher-v5. Findings apply only to this simulator and configuration; no real-world deployment claim is permitted.
